about.title: Menene saitin Mandelbrot
about.lede: Shi ne abu mafi rikitarwa a lissafin lissafi, kuma ana samar da shi ta hanyar layi ɗaya na lissafin da yaro zai iya bi. Wannan shafin yana magana ne game da dalilin da ya sa hakan ke da ban mamaki.
about.rule.heading: Ka'ida ɗaya, maimaita
about.rule.p1: Zaɓi wuri a kan jirgin sama mai faɗi. Sanya shi, ƙara batun da kuka fara da shi, kuma kuna da sabon batu. Ƙaddamar da cewa, ƙara ainihin kuma, kuma ci gaba da tafiya har abada.
about.rule.p2: Abubuwa biyu na iya faruwa. Makiyoyin na iya yawo kuma ba za su dawo ba, suna tsere zuwa iyaka. Ko kuma za su iya zama a kusa da gida komai tsawon lokacin da kuka ci gaba da squaring. Saitin Mandelbrot shine kawai tarin wuraren farawa waɗanda ke tsayawa.
about.rule.p3: Wannan shi ne ma'anar duka. Yankin baki a cikin kowane hoto akan wannan rukunin yanar gizon shine saitin kansa;
about.surprise.heading: Babu wanda ya tsara sifar
about.surprise.p1: Dokar ba ta ƙunshi da'ira ba, babu karkace, babu dokin teku, babu walƙiya. Yana da ninkawa da ƙari. Duk abin da kuke iya gani an riga an nuna shi ta waɗannan ayyuka guda biyu, suna jiran wani ya shirya shi.
about.surprise.p2: Wannan shi ne bangaren da ke damun mutanen da suka hadu da shi yadda ya kamata. Ba a ƙirƙira sifar ba kuma ba za a iya daidaita ta ba. Canja ƙa'idar kuma kuna samun wani abu daban, ba sigar wannan mafi kyawun kyan gani ba. An tilasta kowane daki-daki.
about.boundary.heading: Gefen baya warwarewa
about.boundary.p1: Yawancin siffofi suna samun sauƙi yayin da kuke duba kusa. Ba za a iya bambanta da'irar da aka yi girma da madaidaicin layi ba. Gefen saitin Mandelbrot yana yin akasin haka: kowane haɓaka yana buɗe tsarin da ba a iya gani a da, kuma yana yin haka ba tare da ƙarewa ba.
about.boundary.p2: Ciki shine na yau da kullun don aunawa - yankinsa yana kusan 1.506. Iyakar ba. A cikin 1998 Mitsuhiro Shishikura ya tabbatar da cewa yana da girman juzu'i 2, wanda shine madaidaicin hanyar faɗin cewa lanƙwasa ba ta da kauri tana gudanar da cunkoso kamar saman da aka cika.
about.copies.heading: Kwafi na duka, amma ba sosai ba
about.copies.p1: Zuƙowa cikin iyakar ko'ina kuma a ƙarshe wani ƙaramin tsibirin baƙar fata ya bayyana, babu shakka irin siffar da kuka fara. Wadannan yawanci ana kiran su minibrots, kuma akwai da yawa daga cikinsu marasa iyaka, a kowane ma'auni, har zuwa ƙasa.
about.copies.p2: Ba ainihin kwafi ba ne. Kowannensu ya lalace, kuma kowanne an naɗe shi cikin yanayin yanayi - karkace, filaye, sarƙoƙi na ƙananan tsibiran - waɗanda ke na wurin kuma babu wani. Saitin yana maimaita jigon sa ba tare da ya sake maimaita kansa ba.
about.atlas.heading: Manuniya ce ta sauran duniyoyi
about.atlas.p1: Gudun ka'ida iri ɗaya amma riƙe ƙarar batu da aka gyara, kuma kuna samun wani abu daban da ake kira Julia set. Akwai daya ga kowane batu a cikin jirgin, kuma suna jere daga madaukai masu tsabta da aka haɗa zuwa ƙurar da aka cire.
about.atlas.p2: Saitin Mandelbrot ya zama ainihin taswirar wanda shine. Wani batu a cikinsa yayi daidai da saita Julia a cikin yanki ɗaya; Hoto ne guda ɗaya wanda ke keɓance dangin wasu marasa iyaka, kuma babu wanda ya sanya wannan kayan a wurin da gangan ko dai.
about.discovery.heading: An samo shi, ba a yi ba
about.discovery.p1: Hoton farko da aka sani shine Robert Brooks da Peter Matelski suka buga a cikin 1978. Benoit Mandelbrot, yana aiki a IBM, ya samar da hotuna a 1980 kuma ya gane abin da yake kallo;
about.discovery.p2: Lissafin da ke bayansa ya tsufa har yanzu, yana komawa Pierre Fatou da Gaston Julia a kusa da 1918, waɗanda suka yi nazarin waɗannan abubuwan shekaru da yawa kafin a sami wata na'ura da za ta iya zana sakamakon. Sun kasance suna tunani game da siffar da babu ɗayansu da zai iya gani.
about.discovery.p3: Kowa, a ko'ina, yin lissafin ƙa'ida ɗaya yana samun abu iri ɗaya har zuwa filament na ƙarshe. Ta haka ba a samar da shi a 1980 ba. An same shi a can.
about.scale.heading: Yaya nisa wannan ya tafi
about.scale.p1: Hotunan a nan sun kai girman kusan 10⁴¹. Idan an zana dukkan saitin a wannan ma'auni akan allo mai faɗin mita, allon zai zama mafi girman sau ɗaruruwan tiriliyan fiye da sararin da ake gani don riƙe shi.
about.scale.p2: Babu ɗayan waɗannan bayanan da aka adana a ko'ina. Ana lissafta shi akan buƙata, daga ƙa'idar layi ɗaya, duk lokacin da kuka duba. Babu wani hoto mai tushe da ake ɗaukaka - akwai lissafi kawai, kuma yana ci gaba har abada.
about.explore.heading: Ku je ku duba
about.explore.p1: Ja don motsawa, gungura zuwa zuƙowa. Shafin Wuraren yana da jeri na wuraren da ya kamata a gani, gami da tsibiri mai zurfi wanda ke da wurare arba'in da biyu a ƙasa. Duk abin da kuka samu yana cikin mashin adireshi, don haka ana iya raba kowane ra'ayi azaman hanyar haɗi.
ui.title: Mandelbrot
ui.autoIterationsHint: Zaɓi ƙidayar maimaitawa daga matakin zuƙowa. Matsar da silima yana kashe wannan.
ui.hint.drag: Ja zuwa kwanon rufi, gungura don zuƙowa. URL koyaushe yana riƙe da cikakken yanayin.
ui.hint.depthLimit: A wannan iyakar zurfin zurfin baya.
ui.hint.gamma: Haɗin palette da walƙiya suna gudana a cikin hasken layi;
ui.error.stopped: An dakatar da yin aiki. Wannan yawanci yana nufin direban zane ya daina kan firam ɗin da ya ɗauki tsayi da yawa. Rage ƙididdige ƙididdigewa kuma sake shigar da shafin.
ui.notice.noWebgpu: Wannan burauzar ba ta amfani da WebGPU, don haka mai gabatarwa ya sake komawa zuwa WebGL2, wanda ke tafiya daidai a cikin zuƙowa mai zurfi.
ui.notice.enableFlag: Idan burauzar ku tana goyan bayan WebGPU amma baya amfani da shi, buɗe chrome://flags, saita Lissafin Mayar da software zuwa An kunna, sa'annan ta sake kunna mai binciken. Shafin chrome://gpu ya bayyana dalilin da ya sa aka ƙi shi.
ui.notice.mobile: A waya ko kwamfutar hannu mai gabatarwa yana aiki, amma zuƙowa mai zurfi suna da nisa a hankali fiye da na GPU na tebur, kuma zurfin ra'ayi na iya ɗaukar daƙiƙa da yawa a firam. Rage ƙidayar maimaitawa yana taimakawa.
